context: Our formulation flips this around. Instead of considering samples P from J (or ∂J) we consider samples Q from some domain Ω ⊂ Rd . This leads to new but similar sampling theory, still depending on some feature size (represented by various scale parameters ρ, τ , and η), and still allowing recovery properties of the underlying objects. While the samples P from J can be used to estimate Hausdorff distance via an all-pairs O(|P |2 )-time comparison, our formulation requires only a O(|Q|)-time comparison to compute dQ .
